_comment: Whale leg aimed at a 70% settled win rate: among screened wallets, follow up to 5 whose own already-closed markets won at least 70% of the time, with at least 15 such markets and positive settled profit, ordered by that profit. 5% of equity per copied buy, 25% cap per market, leader buys under $100 ignored. Same 60 min latency, 0.01 slippage, taker fees, and 0.10 don't-chase rule. Their win rate is not our win rate; the walk-forward measures the copy.
